brief:
Israel's restrictions on medical supplies for dental treatment are inflicting both physical and psychological pain on Gaza residents, We Are Not Numbers reported. The blockade has severely limited access to essential dental materials, leaving patients unable to receive necessary care and treatment.

The crisis compounds Gaza's broader health emergency, as dentists struggle to operate without adequate equipment and medications. Residents endure prolonged suffering from untreated dental conditions, with the limitations affecting quality of life and overall wellbeing across the territory.
dek: Israel’s restrictions on medical supplies for dental treatment are inflicting physical and psychological pain on people in Gaza.
title: Israel's supply restrictions worsen Gaza dental care crisis
